title: How a Barcode Scanner Works in 60 Seconds 🛒🔴 #shorts
description:
A barcode scanner reads stripes with light. A red beam sweeps across the code, black bars soak up the light and white gaps bounce it back, and a sensor turns that flicker into numbers. The checkout looks up the number to find the product and its price. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#barcode #scanner #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: The very first barcode scan, in *1974*, was a pack of *chewing gum*.

steps.label: Beam
steps.text: The scanner sweeps a thin *red beam* of light across the stripes.

steps.label: Bars
steps.text: *Black bars* soak up the light, and *white gaps* bounce it back.

steps.label: Sensor
steps.text: A light *sensor* sees that flicker and turns it into an *electric signal*.

steps.label: Numbers
steps.text: The widths of bars and gaps spell out *12 digits*, the product's *code*.

steps.label: Price
steps.text: The checkout looks up that code, finds the *price*, and *beeps*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Light, stripes, *numbers*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
